Action: Interview target customers in the top two markets and validate willingness to switch suppliers.

Action: Create win/loss and competitor feature tracker for priority accounts.

Why_It_Matters: Makes competitor analysis ongoing rather than one-time.

Action: Confirm target price corridor and minimum contribution margin.
Why_It_Matters: Prevents growth assumptions from ignoring economics.

Action: Run two paid or structured pilots with Tier-1 / charging customers.
Why_It_Matters: Creates evidence before broader market entry.

Action: Evaluate one local technical sales or distribution partner in the second-priority market.
Why_It_Matters: Reduces the cost of testing a new market.

Action: Adapt documentation, certification and integration support to top customer requirements.
Why_It_Matters: Turns market interest into implementable offers.

Action: Build a named-account plan for top OEM/Tier-1/charging prospects.
Why_It_Matters: Focuses commercial effort on specific buyers.

Action: Enter the next Tier-1 market only if pilot and pipeline thresholds are met.
Success_Metric: Go/no-go based on revenue pipeline and pilot conversion
